title: No one even asked me to sit
odia:
ମାଲୋ ମଲି,
ଗାଁ ଚାରିଆଡ଼େ ବୁଲି ଆଇଲି...
କେହି ନକହିଲେ ବସ ବୋଲି...!!!
literal_meaning: Oh mother, I am undone! I went all around the village; no one said, “Sit down.”
explanation: The complaint turns a small invitation into the measure of being welcomed. After going everywhere, the speaker has not received even that acknowledgement. The exaggerated opening can make the hurt comic, while the last line reveals the modest courtesy that was missing.
meaning_odia: ସବୁଆଡ଼େ ଯାଇ ମଧ୍ୟ ସାମାନ୍ୟ ଆଦର ନ ମିଳିବାର ଦୁଃଖ ପ୍ରକାଶ କରିବା।
usage_example: A visitor calls on several acquaintances and feels brushed aside by all of them, then recounts the experience with this lament. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The source places it under a gloss about not receiving due respect. The dramatic ମଲି is rendered as an exclamation, not a report of death. No universal village hospitality rule is inferred.
